command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp NUMBA_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/numba
cd /tmp
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
# No PATH export: aarchsci env images already have their python first (unlike aarchbio).
# NUMBA_CACHE_DIR because numba writes its JIT cache under $HOME by default.

echo "== staged bytes must match their pin =="
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: identities.py does not match its pin"; exit 1; }

# python3 -u so a killed run still has its output in command.log.
python3 -u identities.py 2>&1 | tee identities.log
RC="${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
test "$RC" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: an identity failed"; exit 1; }

free -g | awk '/^Mem:/{print "mem_total_gib\t"$2}'
uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo "DONE"
